strings.tab.title: Gameplay
strings.page.intro: Change supported Stellar Souls options while the game is running. Turning an option off restores its captured value. Some tables load when entering an area.
strings.page.base_attributes: Enable custom health, shield, and damage reduction
strings.page.enable_gauges: Enable custom Beta, Burst and Tachy capacity
strings.page.lower_capacity: Use lower Beta and Burst capacity
strings.page.skill_cooldowns: Use Stellar Souls skill costs and cooldowns
strings.page.forgiving_just: Increase perfect parry and dodge window
strings.page.dash_cooldown: Set dash attack cooldown to 4 seconds
strings.page.world_fishing: Change fishing difficulty and fight time
strings.page.fish_fight_time_percent: Fish fight time percent of original
strings.page.builder_static: Builder options that still need generated mods
strings.page.builder_static_details: Combat and damage profiles; SkinSuit/outfit and CNS helper; mini-bosses, enemy variety and overworld bosses; environment-death changes and automatic gauge effects; drop probability; and challenge/moveset packages remain desktop Builder features. They require creating rows, enums/arrays/references, changing spawns, assets, or helper files that CPS runtime reflection cannot safely reproduce.
strings.page.disable_all: Disable all and restore captured values
strings.page.searching: Waiting for the game data tables...
strings.page.ready: Ready. No runtime changes are active.
strings.page.applied: Updated %d field(s); %d could not be changed.
strings.page.restored: Restored %d field(s); %d changed elsewhere and were left untouched.
strings.page.ambiguous: Duplicate data table objects were found; affected tables were skipped.
strings.page.error: Could not initialize the game reflection API. See CPS.log.
strings.page.save_error: Could not save the plugin settings. See CPS.log.
